terrain_switch.scope: 1072matched actual point predictions, not voxel means or full-domain sensitivity. WRF terrain-dependent flow remains in both cases. Does not demonstrate identical CALPUFF versus particle-model terrain physics.

CALPUFF.source: common_CAL_volume_cost_r01/massbal.dat. Printed g; timestep Emitted/OUT/Transformed/Wet/Dry are increments; DomainTotal is end-state.

scope: Three facilities, five outlets; source-only, no initial background or chemistry. Model spread, not observed ambient error.
weighting: All360hourly means included. WGS84cellarea x layerthickness for full volume; cellarea for0–20mAGL. No concentration clipping, agreement mask, coordinate-Jacobian rescaling or smoothing in statistics.
normalization: Signed difference B-A. RelativeRMSE uses RMS(A), a model reference, not truth; not MAPE or a percent-of-mean error.
